title: Supporting the Digital Transformation of SMEs in Serbia: SME Policy Index for Western Balkans and Türkiye 2026 – Economy Profile for Serbia | OECD
content:
As for financial support for the SME uptake of AI, most funding streams relevant to emerging technologies in Serbia are concentrated in the start-up and high-tech ecosystem, rather than targeting the broader SME base. The Innovation Fund supports advanced technology development, including AI, IoT and robotics, through the implementation of its programmes [(Innovation Fund, [...] access to funding pathways for scaling digital solutions. It also facilitates collaboration between SMEs, research institutions, and technology providers, serving as a connector within Serbia’s innovation ecosystem.
